title: Learning Structured Sparsity for Large Models: Bridging Model Compressibility and Efficient Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.31897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling laws continue to reward increases in model scale, while the resulting computational and memory demands drive greater reliance on cloud infrastructure for inference. Yet unreliable network connectivity, communication delays, and privacy requirements can make such reliance impractical, motivating local execution on edge devices. Local deployment requires models to fit within limited memory and execute efficiently with the available computational resources. Recent work has shown that learning sparse-plus-low-rank representations enables elastic compression of a single checkpoint to multiple memory budgets. However, fewer parameters do not necessarily translate into faster inference. Indexing overhead and irregular memory access in unstructured sparse components can offset computational savings. translated_title: 面向大模型的结构化稀疏学习：弥合模型可压缩性与高效推理之间的鸿沟
translated_abstract: 缩放定律持续推动着模型规模的增长，而由此产生的计算与内存需求使得推理日益依赖云基础设施。然而，不稳定的网络连接、通信延迟以及隐私要求可能使这种依赖变得不切实际，从而促使人们转向在边缘设备上进行本地执行。本地部署要求模型能够适应有限的内存，并在可用的计算资源下高效运行。近期研究表明，学习“稀疏+低秩”表示能够将单个模型检查点弹性压缩至多个内存预算。然而，参数数量的减少并不一定转化为更快的推理速度。非结构化稀疏组件中的索引开销和不规则内存访问可能会抵消计算上的节省。为解决这一关键的部署障碍，我们提出了S-SALAAD，这是一个统一框架，可联合学习模型权重及其低（注：原摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出统一框架S-SALAAD，联合学习模型权重与结构化稀疏+低秩表示，使大模型既能弹性压缩以适配边缘设备的多种内存预算，又能实现真正加速的高效推理。
en_tdlr: S-SALAAD, a unified framework that jointly learns model weights and their structured sparse-plus-low-rank representations, bridging model compressibility and efficient inference for elastic edge deployment.
